descricao: RIKEN is Japan’s leading national comprehensive research institute for basic and applied science and a world leader in a diverse array of scientific disciplines. We aim to create an innovative research platform that effectively generates new fields of knowledge across research fields by cross-linking cutting-edge research platforms. Researchers from a diverse range of research fields will hybridize them to create ‘new wisdom’ that transcends existing research fields, promotes the restructuring of academic science, and contributes to the international community by proposing solutions to global-scale issues. We will also promote mutually beneficial collaborations with universities and other academic institutions, as well as industry, to contribute to the resolution of challenges facing human society and expand RIKEN's intellectual value. titulo: Data and Computational Sciences Integration Research Program (CoRe)
descricao: Director: Shinji Tsuneyuki (Ph.D.) CoRe is a program carrying out research and development on the following themes: Construction and upgrading of a quantum-supercomputer hybrid platform; Development of a high-quality data storage and data use environment; Advanced simulation methods to make the best use of such data; Collaboration between data science and computational science and prediction algorithm development. We are expanding computationally viable regions and pioneering the science of predictive control in the future. The results of this research will be pioneeringly used for problems in diverse research fields, such as physics, chemistry, and life science. This program will find new scientific horizons and clues to solving global-scale issues, thereby opening up pathways of knowledge toward a better future. descricao: Director: Naoto Nagaosa (D.Sc.) Although quantum science and technology are advancing rapidly, we still lack a deep understanding of their basic principles. Our Fundamental Quantum Science Program focuses on four key areas—basic physics and chemistry, mathematics, quantum information, and nonequilibrium science—returning to the foundations of quantum science and advancing research from a mid- to long-term perspective. As core measures, we are not only promoting research and human resource exchange through workshops, visitor programs, and seminars featuring top-class researchers but are also fostering collaboration and intellectual exchanges. To support these efforts, we are building an organizational structure that is both flexible and solid, going beyond traditional organizational forms. Ultimately, our goal is to create a world-class fundamental quantum science research center, form a hub for brain circulation, and foster personnel for fundamental quantum science research. Deputy Director: Shinya Aoki (D.Sc.), Masahito Ueda (D.Sc.), Norio Kawakami (D.Eng.) Fundamental Quantum Science Program Strong Correlation Theory Research Group Job Openings at Fundamental Quantum Science Program

titulo: RIKEN Program for Drug Discovery and Medical Technology Platforms (DMP)
descricao: Director: Yoichi Kurebayashi (D.V.M., Ph.D.) Drug discovery is the process of identifying disease-causing molecules and developing appropriate therapeutic modalities to modulate them, ultimately translating these advances into medical practice. DMP aims to generate innovative pharmaceuticals from outstanding basic research while also establishing and implementing translational science that supports drug discovery. In addition, the program advances original drug discovery research based on RIKEN’s cutting-edge science and technology, including radiopharmaceuticals and data-driven drug discovery leveraging AI and quantum computing. Through close collaboration with industry and medical institutions, DMP seeks to translate the outcomes of basic research into clinical applications, thereby contributing to the advancement of next-generation medicine. 1.Modalities for drug discovery 3.Monoclonal antibody drugs and vaccines 4.Cell-based drugs and regenerative medicine 5.New technology for drug discovery and medical technology platforms RIKEN Program for Drug Discovery and Medical Technology Platforms Job Openings at RIKEN Program for Drug Discovery and Medical Technology Platforms

descricao: Director: Tadahiro Kuroda (Ph.D.) As the technology for generative AI develops and its use expands dramatically, reducing energy consumption has become an urgent issue. In order to achieve ultra-low power consumption for AI servers, technological innovation is required for the semiconductor devices used in generative AI. The Advanced Semiconductor Science Program (ASSP) promotes the design and development of semiconductor devices that can be used in next-generation supercomputing infrastructures, integrated device for advanced computational science, and the foundation for new science, such as quantum innovation, in collaboration with various research centers within RIKEN. In addition, we aim to reduce the cost of design and apply it to edge AI through collaboration with universities and companies in Japan and overseas. Job Openings at Advanced Semiconductor Science Program

descricao: The RIKEN Baton Zone Program manages and supports the transfer of RIKEN’s scientific achievements into commercial products through partnerships with private companies. Under this program, researchers from RIKEN and private companies work together on focused research projects tackling specific technological challenges. The scope of the program is twofold: on one hand it provides opportunities for corporate researchers and technicians to work in RIKEN laboratories, and on the other it supports the creation of research teams working on projects proposed by private companies. descricao: The mission of the RIKEN Information R&D and Strategy Headquarters (R-IH) is to promote and operate RIKEN’s information infrastructure and information research, in a strategic and integrated way. The Headquarters consists of two divisions and a cross-cutting research project. The Information Security & Systems Division carries out the continuous operation of a secure information system infrastructure and information environment, ensuring information security, and educating and promoting compliance with information ethics. The Infrastructure Research and Development Division contributes to the promotion of Open Science throughout RIKEN. In addition, the Headquarters operates the project carrying out R&D for the social implementation of next-generation robots, which are constructively demonstrated from computational elucidation of the human mind, especially recognition. titulo: RIKEN Center for Sustainable Resource Science (CSRS)
descricao: Human activities are rapidly pushing the resilience and stability that the Earth system naturally possesses to its limits. To contribute to the harmony between human activities and the Earth system, the Center for Sustainable Resource Science (CSRS) is promoting four strategic programs: 'Sustainable Bioproduction', 'Material Circulation and Catalysis', 'Symbiosis and Environment', and 'Advanced Research and Technology Platforms'. CSRS is advancing the development of stress-resistant plants and environmentally friendly crop production technologies, and is engaged in manufacturing that utilizes the power of organisms and catalysts. By collaborating with researchers in the computational science and the prediction science, as well as experts from the humanities and social sciences fields, CSRS aims to bring the achievements of fundamental science to society. Through the power of science, CSRS contributes to solving global challenges toward the realization of a sustainable circular society and preserving the global commons, and opens our future where both the Earth and humanity can live healthily together. descricao: RIKEN Center for Advanced Photonics (RAP) is at the forefront of photonics research, paving the way for extraordinary breakthroughs in the observation, analysis and information capabilities of light. We are driving cutting-edge research that opens new frontiers in various scientific fields. Light, that most familiar and intriguing of phenomena, has been and continues to be, the most powerful tool in our quest to explore and understand the world around us. The groundbreaking discovery that light is a quantum, known as a “photon”, has led to the remarkable development of quantum physics and has formed the very foundation of modern society. At RAP, we are on a mission to unlock the boundless potential of light by fostering cutting-edge research across various “edges” of photonics. We are developing state-of-the-art photonics, including ultrahigh-precision optical lattice clocks and attosecond lasers, photonics in interdisciplinary research areas exploring fundamental questions of life science and space, and photonics that seamlessly integrates artificial intelligence to bridge the virtual and physical worlds. We are delighted to have the opportunity to work together to build a new optical age and share our dreams of new developments in photonics science.
